notes.title: Runeyana was accidentally released as a full release.
notes.notes: We would like to apologize ourselves to the people who bought Runeyana with the belief that it was a fully released game. We accidentally launched it as the full version without being finished yet. However, thanks to Valve's support, Runeyana is back to Early Access. The game is still unfinished and lot of content will be added before the final release. We have read all your reviews and we will fix all the issues within the game and we will even add more features. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Runeyana update!
notes.notes:
All players chests now apear on minimap. 

Now you can easely hunt others players chests and loot it.

Already looted chests by you will not popup on the minimap.
